header.dragHint: Drag a widget from {compose} to get started.

sidebar.savedHere: Reports are saved in this browser.

unsaved.title: Save changes to “{name}”?
unsaved.body: Your changes to this report haven't been saved yet.

create.title: New report
create.intro: Start from a blank page and build it with the widgets in {compose}.

delete.title: Delete report?
delete.bodyReset: “{name}” will go back to the report shipped with the app. Your saved changes to it will be lost.
delete.body: “{name}” will be removed from this browser. This can't be undone.

resetDemo.title: Reset the demo?
resetDemo.body: All reports you've created will be deleted and “{name}” will go back to its original state, including any unsaved changes. This can't be undone.

empty.title: No PayPal data yet
empty.body: This sandbox account has no invoices, products, plans or transactions. Create some in the PayPal sandbox, then refresh to build reports from them.

error.title: We couldn't load your PayPal data
error.body: The PayPal sandbox didn't respond as expected. Check the API credentials in .env.local and try again.

guide.title: How to use this dashboard
guide.intro: Built with AG Studio. Keep this open while you try each step.

read.title: Read a page
read.body: Each widget answers one question; its title says which. Point at a bar or a band to see its numbers.

filter.title: Filter by clicking
filter.click: Click an agent in {flow}, or a bar in a chart, and every other widget on the page shows only that. Click it again to clear it.
filter.panel: Open {filters} at the right edge for the page's filters and the ones you clicked.

pages.title: Move between pages and reports
pages.menu: The pages of the open report are listed in the left menu under {dashboard}. {addPage} adds an empty one; double-click a page or a report to rename it.
pages.reports: {newReport} starts a blank report. A report's ⋯ menu has {rename}, {duplicate} and delete. {resetDemo} brings back the built-in report and removes the ones you made.

edit.title: Edit a page
edit.open: Press {edit}. Two panels open at the right: {compose} and {data}.
edit.add: Add a widget: in {compose}, open {widgets} and drag one onto the page. Or drag a field from {data} (an agent, a customer, an amount) onto the page and Studio makes a chart of it.
edit.change: Change a widget: click it. Its setup shows in {compose}: chart type, the fields on each axis, sorting and its titles.
edit.move: Move or resize: drag a widget to move it, or drag its edges to resize it. Its toolbar duplicates or deletes it.
edit.save: Undo and redo are next to {save}. {save} keeps the report in this browser; {discard} drops the changes; {view} leaves editing.

guardWidget.title: Add the guard's own widget
guardWidget.body: In {compose} › {widgets}, the {group} group has {flow}: every agent's calls through the guard to what it did. Drag it onto any page.

export.title: Export
export.body: A table or chart's toolbar downloads its rows as CSV, or the chart as an image.

ai.title: Ask the AI
ai.on: In {edit}, open the {assistant} and describe the widget you want, for example “stopped refunds by customer”. It builds it on the page, and you keep or discard it like any other change.
ai.off: The {assistant} builds widgets from a sentence. It appears in Edit mode once an OpenAI key is set on the server (see the README).

stoppedMost.label: Which agent was stopped most?
stoppedMost.prompt: Which AI agent did the payment guard stop most often, and for which reasons? Use the guard decisions and violations.

protectedVsMoved.label: Money protected vs moved
protectedVsMoved.prompt: How much money did the guard protect by blocking, compared with what the agents moved and billed? Break it down by agent and action.

waiting.label: What waits for a person?
waiting.prompt: List the held actions still awaiting approval, oldest first, with the agent, action, customer and amount.

blockRate.label: Chart the block rate
blockRate.prompt: Add a line chart of the guard block rate per day, split by agent.

summarise.label: Summarise this page
summarise.prompt: Summarise what this page shows: every widget, the fields it reads, and what stands out.

flow.title: Flow through the guard
flow.subtitle: Every call your agents made, from the agent to what the guard did with it. Click an agent to filter the page.

kpiProtected.caption: Refunds and claims the guard stopped

kpiWaiting.title: Waiting for you

kpiWithheld.caption: Customer details kept from the agents

reasons.subtitle: The rule each stopped call broke, most frequent first
